action_hash(): any password in the action is first replaced by its scrypt derivation (n=2^14), then the action is SHA-256'd for the grant binding; the binding is wiped once the grant is spent. CodeQL cannot see through the scrypt step.
A test's pass line prints the check's label, a fixed description written in the test; no credential reaches it.

reviewed.line: fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o640)
reviewed.reason: A sandboxed program's output in the run's own slot (agenti-run:agenti-run). Group read is what the slot's other files have, so root's link-safe reader and the run can use it; it replaced open('w'), which made it 0644.
